name: browser-laucher
//optionalDependencies: playwright-with-fingerprints pulls browser-with-fingerprints, which declares os=win32 and fails the whole install with EBADPLATFORM on Linux and macOS. It is the BAS engine binding, and BAS is Windows-only anyway - ShardX does its own fingerprinting through --fingerprint-profile. Optional so npm installs everything else on those platforms instead of refusing outright.
